architecture: opt-in FirmwareBoardConfig::pci_ecam: code 7 (a v1.0 slot) becomes PRESENT MMIO from PCI_ECAM_DESCRIPTOR; the generic MMIO loop of board_map adds a MemoryRegionKind::Mmio region; one PciEcam bus device gets MmioBinding(0xFC10_0000) + PortRegionBinding(0xCF8, 8) with one device_index

handoff.default: byte for byte unchanged (golden test handoff_block_is_byte_identical_to_the_reference), code 7 PRESENT = 0
handoff.with_flag: version_minor 0, device_count 7, region_count +1 (MMIO, owner_device 6), total_size +32, code 7 PRESENT = 1; other six entries unchanged; boot page table count unchanged

not_implemented: any PCI function declared by the board
pci_sanity_check acceptance by Linux (direct.c:204-216 needs BIOS DMI year >= 2001, or any bus-0 function of class 0x0600 or 0x0300, or vendor Intel/Compaq; workaround pci=nochecks)
